name: Europe hybrid attacks
summary: Drones closed Jersey airport two nights running; Romania blames Russia for ship sinking
state: Drones disrupted Jersey Airport on the nights of 30 and 31 Oct; officials met on 1 Nov to review the response, police are seeking specialist UK support and no operator has been identified (LBC). Romania blamed Russia after a drone sank a ship in the Black Sea on 23 Oct. Bloomberg reported on 27 Oct that Russia-linked hackers have caused physical disruption in about 20 countries.
for_you: Drone sightings can cause short-notice flight delays and diversions. Check with your airline before travelling.
rubric_hit: Drone incursions closed an airport; attack attributed to a state
